product_metadata.title: Jobar 24" Flex Light Strip
description: Light strip bends & sticks to any angle or curve. Ideal for drawers, shelves, cabinets, display cases, pantries & more. Bendable. Super bright LEDs. Easy to install. No hardware required. Batteries included. Patent Pending.
